messages.subject: Full-day ctmm workshop at TWS 2021
parts:
The Wildlife Society's 2021 Annual Conference will host a one-day ctmm workshop and a new ctmm feature presentations. TWS workshops are first come, first served and there are a limited number of seats available. The workshop will be on November 1. Registration is open. Early registration ends on July 31.

Introduction to continuous-time movement modeling for animal tracking data
  • Location: Virtual
  • Date: November 1, 2021
  • Time: 10:00 am – 6:00 pm EST

Best,
Chris

messages.subject: Re: Full-day ctmm workshop at TWS 2021
parts:
For anyone at TWS, we have a talk on the new RSF capabilities in ctmm, "Some Useful Results for Applying Resource Selection Functions", https://tws.econference.io/public/WEnr07C/main/sessions/3589/11720
with a live Q&A session on Thursday November 04, 02:00 PM - 03:00 PM EST from the same page. Feel free to drop by and chat about RSFs or anything else.

Best,
Chris
